title: Remove scroll effect and change hero background to white

requirements.summary: Remove scroll-based parallax or animation effects from the homepage hero section
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section no longer has scroll-triggered animations or parallax effects
Content remains static during page scroll

file_operations.description: Remove any scroll event listeners, parallax effects, transform animations, or CSS classes that trigger on scroll. Remove any useEffect hooks monitoring scroll position. Ensure all hero content remains static during page scroll while preserving existing Spanish text and CTAs.

requirements.summary: Change hero section background to white for improved text readability
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section background is white or very light colored
All text in the hero section has sufficient contrast and is easily readable
The hero background image is no longer visible or has been replaced with a solid white background

file_operations.description: Replace the hero background image overlay (currently using frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png) with a solid white background. Remove or comment out any background-image CSS properties or img tags referencing the hero background. Set background-color to white or a very light color (e.g., bg-white). Adjust text colors if needed to ensure sufficient contrast against the white background while preserving all existing Spanish content.
